proposal.summary: Path traversal in NimbusDocs file download endpoint allows attacker to read arbitrary files; reporter downloaded /etc/passwd.
proposal.cwe_quote: Path traversal in the file download endpoint of NimbusDocs lets me read /etc/passwd.

PR.quote: Path traversal in the file download endpoint of NimbusDocs lets me read /etc/passwd.
